verdict.rationale: The New York Department of State is a government registry that accepts corporate filings, issues certified copies and runs entity searches, so self-hosting its core product is a category error for this kind of service. A sovereign filing authority cannot be deployed by a user. Nothing in the evidence shows any downloadable, deployable or open-source edition that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
